newsitem.title: USA: Guidant gets FDA clearance for catheter.
newsitem.headline: Guidant gets FDA clearance for catheter.

text.p: Guidant Corp said on Wednesday it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market its ACS RX COMET VP Coronary Dilatation Catheter in the United States.

The company said the catheter, manufactured by a unit of Guidant's Vascular Intervention Group, represents the latest advance in technology used to open blocked arteries during interventional cardiology procedures.
The new product is expected to be released worldwide in March, Guidant said.
Guidant said nearly 750,000 people worldwide undergo a procedure that requires an angioplasty catheter. The procedure is an alternative to coronary bypass surgery for some patients, the company said.
Guidant provides products and services to the global cardiology and minimally invasive surgery marketplaces.
Its shares were trading up 3/8 Wednesday at 65.
